description.zh-CN: 在树城、飞瀑与金色花窗间阅读时间，归档秘典，触发草、水、雷的元素共鸣。
description.en: A lush tree-city, gilded botanical tracery, living water and a garden of elemental resonance.

concept.world: An original Sumeru-inspired garden of knowledge: monumental tree-city, cascading water, gilded leaves and illuminated manuscripts.
concept.mood: Luminous, elaborate and botanical, with quiet reading spaces preserved around the scene.
concept.type: Locally bundled Chinese serif typography, warm gold chapter labels and stable serif clock numerals.
concept.motion: Layered pollen, leaf shadows and water glints at 24 fps. Up to three bounded reaction bursts. Hidden and reduced-motion modes are still.

metaphors.tidy-files: Secret codices are archived; the subtitle explains actual file movement.
metaphors.quit-apps: A journey rests by asking eligible applications to quit normally.
metaphors.resonance: Water with the garden's grass blooms; lightning with grass traces quickening veins. This is an artistic interpretation, not game combat simulation.

requirements.request: Lavish botanical Sumeru scene distinct from Three Body
requirements.implementation: Original background artwork, gold SVG tracery, manuscript controls and elemental petals

requirements.request: Clock, weather, archive, folder entry and app wind-down
requirements.implementation: SDK data bindings and explicit built-in action controls with actual-purpose subtitles
requirements.verification: Demo action transitions; actual OS actions require separate authorized use

requirements.implementation: Interactive garden seal, three element choices, layered blooms and branching light veins
requirements.verification: Browser click, repeated activation and fixture checks

requirements.implementation: 24 fps, DPR at most 1.5, 1400px longest canvas side, 3 reaction slots, hidden/reduced-motion still mode
requirements.verification: Runtime state and browser interaction checks; machine energy use unmeasured

requirements.request: A genuine local extra distinct from Three Body
requirements.implementation: A botanical note seal with Chinese text, local automatic saving, close/reopen recovery and explicit clear
requirements.verification: Browser typing, blur, close and reload tests
